classes.CodBi_LDAP_AC_Mail: Apply to an XTextField representing an email address. Autocompletes from LDAP directory when the entered mail matches an LDAP entry.
classes.CodBi_LDAP_AC_FirstName: Apply to an XTextField representing a first name. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP givenName).
classes.CodBi_LDAP_AC_LastName: Apply to an XTextField representing a last name/surname. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP sn).
classes.CodBi_LDAP_AC_Title: Apply to an XTextField representing a job title. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP title).
classes.CodBi_LDAP_AC_Department: Apply to an XTextField representing a department. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP department).
classes.CodBi_LDAP_AC_Telephone: Apply to an XTextField representing a phone number. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP telephoneNumber).
classes.CodBi_LDAP_AC_Account: Apply to an XTextField representing a username/account name. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP sAMAccountName).
classes.CodBi_LDAP_AC_CommonName: Apply to an XTextField representing a common name. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP cn).
classes.CodBi_LDAP_AC_DisplayName: Apply to an XTextField representing a display name. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP displayName).
